notes_for_editor: Story is about 123 words, near the floor of the range, because the sources give only a location, a 1934 pole L-4 tower and a destroyed outcome. No source dates the destruction, so there is no destroyed event. The brief record matches the sources; no corrections. The brief lists access as unknown; I left access out because no source states a public-access level, only the Drive-Up tag. Nothing is said about remains; the Forest Service list has no photo for this site.
